Maybe, maybe not, I really don't know what sells in this space - but this is more about favorites, games you've played and enjoyed that largely use the RTP/edits, rather than what's sold a lot.
For example, I've really enjoyed
Heroines of Words & Spells
. The premise is amusing, focusing on a party where everyone is at odds with their role - the thief is too kind to steal anything of value from most people, the wizard starts with with no spells and each spell requires going through hoops to learn, the warrior is only brave when she's drunk otherwise is so cowardly she's often paralyzed with fright, and the cleric is too morally awful and evil to be allowed to heal more than 1hp. Story is simple but well done, and progress in the game is difficult but feels rewarding.

I enjoyed Last Dream by White Giant RPG studios. The gameplay is a tribute to classic rpgs particually Final Fantasy 1 where you pick the class of your party. I really liked how much there was so much side content to do (arena battles, fishing, finding all the achievements, bounty hunts, solving puzzles etc) and how much replayability there was. The classes all felt helpful too which I liked, the thief can steal from chests in towns without any risk of being caught by the guards and can steal loot from the enemies, the engineer can dig tunnels that help the party get around the world faster and they have skills that boost the power of potions etc.
There's so much to do that the strategy guide is 701 pages long.
